budget_bar.claim: Bar 64 at level start, drains ~1.3-3.3 per action; depletion=death. Blocked no-op moves don't advance patrollers.

chaser_model.claim: Dark-red chaser: dormant till player ends turn within 4 (graph dist). Then if player ends exactly 2 in straight line -> lunge=DEATH; else chaser steps 2 cells along shortest path toward player unless that step lands within 2 of player.

darkred_chaser.claim: Dark red 'r' = chaser: follows player's past trail, moves 2 cells/turn toward where player was ~2 turns ago. Never catches if player keeps moving; deadly if it lands on player.

level2_mechanics.claim: Maze of 3x3 blocks; player moves exactly 2 blocks per press (stops on W cells, passes g). B=wall. Row2 corridor is only route to goal N at (0,12) via (2,12).

level2_red.claim: Red block R at (2,8), purple dot on left edge. Stayed put while player roamed rows 2/4 (even at (4,8) below it), but lunged 2 LEFT onto player when player stopped at (2,6) same row dist 2 -> instant death.

level7_done.claim: Level 7 solved by route through (4,6)->(8,6)->(8,8)->(6,10)->(2,10 destroy red)->(0,10)->(0,12)->(4,12). Chaser lagged 2-3 turns behind.

noops_free.claim: Blocked (no-op) moves do NOT advance patrollers or the bar; effective turn count only advances on real moves.

orange_deadly.claim: Orange contact = death: player must not end a move on an orange's cell either before or after the orange's 2-cell move that turn.

orange_patroller.claim: Orange patroller: moves 2 cells/turn along its corridor after each player move, bounces at ends; dot=next dir. Avoid its post-move cell.

red_lunge.claim: Red: stationary, lunges 2 toward player if player ends 2 apart in its dot-facing line = death. Landing ON red destroys it.
